findings: Frozen benchmark source explicitly discovers three cache paths beyond the per-job console and Kit log. Their actual runtime values have not been queried.
The extension registry config uses ${omni_global_data}/exts. Redirecting it to an empty path could affect dependency resolution; no such change was made.
Research live_adapter subtracts3GiB per training/evaluation job before workload quota and sets2GiB RLIMIT_FSIZE per file. That limit does not establish aggregate native output or cache bounds.
Current R6 settings bind crash dump path and preserve originals, but do not prove total bytes.
next_required: Determine enforceable native output/path limits and CPU-verifiable capacity reductions, then independent review before actual use; do not change runtime dependencies or weaken final coverage.
